# 5 Best Family-Friendly Hotels in Singapore with EV Charging (2026)

Singapore is one of Asia's most EV-ready cities. With over 3,600 public charging points across the island — the highest density of any Southeast Asian country — driving an EV in Singapore is not just practical, it's the smartest way to explore the city with your family.

Whether you're a local family planning a staycation or visiting from Malaysia, Indonesia, or further afield, finding a hotel with EV charging is a major time-saver. Nothing kills vacation momentum quite like hunting for a charger after a long day with tired kids.

We've rounded up Singapore's top 5 family-friendly hotels with excellent EV charging facilities, kids' amenities, and room configurations that actually work for families of four or more.

## 1. Marina Bay Sands

**Location:** 10 Bayfront Ave, Singapore 018956 — the iconic heart of Marina Bay

### EV Charging Details

| Detail | Info |
|--------|------|
| Provider | SP Group + Charge+ |
| Total chargers | 12 (6x AC 22kW + 6x DC 50kW) |
| Location | Basement 3 car park (blue zone) |
| Cost | Free for hotel guests |
| App required | SP Mobile (for activation) |

Marina Bay Sands offers one of the largest hotel EV charging setups in Singapore. Twelve charging bays means you'll almost never wait. The DC 50kW chargers can top up most EVs to 80% in under an hour — perfect while you're unloading luggage and settling in.

**Pro tip:** Register your license plate with the concierge at check-in. The system couples your parking access with charging, so you don't need to juggle multiple cards or apps.

### Family Amenities

- **Sands SkyPark & Infinity Pool** — The world's highest infinity pool (57th floor). Hotel guests only, so it's not crowded. Young children require swim diapers and adult supervision.
- **Family Rooms** — Choose the **Bay View Suite** (65 m²) with separate living area. Rollaway beds and baby cots available on request. Some suites connect to adjoining rooms for larger families.
- **The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands** — Connected indoor mall with Sampan boat rides (canal boats through the mall), **Digital Light Canvas** (interactive light experience mesmerises toddlers), and a massive indoor skating rink.
- **ArtScience Museum** — Permanent FUTURE WORLD exhibition is designed for kids 4-12. Interactive digital art installations where children can colour their own creatures and watch them come to life on giant screens.
- **Spectra Light & Water Show** — Free evening show at the Event Plaza. Runs at 8 PM and 9 PM daily. Bring a blanket — kids love sitting on the grass for this.

### Nearby Family Attractions (Walking Distance)

- **Gardens by the Bay** (5 min walk) — Cloud Forest and Flower Dome are stroller-friendly. The OCBC Skyway (supertree walkway) is a highlight for older kids.
- **Singapore Flyer** (10 min walk) — Asia's largest observation wheel. Family capsules seat up to 28 people.
- **Helix Bridge** — Instagram-worthy pedestrian bridge connecting Marina Bay to the Promenade.

### Verdict

Best for families who want the full Singapore skyline experience with zero charging anxiety. The free guest charging and 12 bays make this the most reliable option. Book the Bay View Suite for maximum space.

## 2. Shangri-La Singapore

**Location:** 22 Orange Grove Road, Singapore 258350 — lush Orchard Road area

### EV Charging Details

| Detail | Info |
|--------|------|
| Provider | Charge+ (by ComfortDelGro) |
| Total chargers | 6 (4x AC 22kW + 2x DC 120kW) |
| Location | Basement 2 car park |
| Cost | Free for hotel guests |
| App required | Charge+ app for DC charging |

The Shangri-La Singapore has upgraded its EV infrastructure significantly in 2025. The two DC 120kW fast chargers are some of the fastest hotel chargers in Singapore — a full charge in 30-40 minutes on most EVs.

### Family Amenities

- **Buddy Club** — Shangri-La's signature kids' club is one of the best in Singapore. Indoor play areas, craft stations, video game corners, and supervised activities for children 4-12. Open 9 AM to 6 PM daily — giving parents guilt-free time.
- **The Line** — Buffet restaurant with a dedicated kids' corner. Mini pizzas, pasta station, ice cream bar, and interactive dessert-making on weekends.
- **Family Pool** — Two outdoor pools (one exclusively for families with young children, shallower and heated). The main pool has a waterslide that's safe for kids 5+.
- **Garden Wing Family Rooms** — The **Garden Wing Superior Room** (45 m²) connects to an adjacent room for families of 5+. Baby amenities include cot, steriliser, baby bath, and child-proofing kits.
- **Children's Menu at All Restaurants** — Every restaurant on-site offers a dedicated kids' menu at affordable prices ($15-25 SGD).

### Nearby Family Attractions

- **Orchard Road** (5 min walk) — Shopping paradise but also home to the **Singapore Art Museum** (SAM at 8Q) with family art workshops on weekends.
- **Botanic Gardens** (10 min walk) — UNESCO World Heritage site. The **Jacob Ballas Children's Garden** is a free, dedicated nature play area for kids under 12. Sandpit, water play, treehouse, and edible garden.
- **ION Orchard** (10 min walk) — The **ION Sky** observatory on the 56th floor offers free panoramic views (weather permitting).

### Verdict

The Shangri-La Singapore is the best choice for families who want a resort-like experience in the city. The Buddy Club is a true differentiator — it's not just a room with toys, it's a properly staffed programme with structured activities. Combine that with free EV charging and you have a winner.

## 3. Resorts World Sentosa (RWS)

**Location:** 8 Sentosa Gateway, Sentosa Island, Singapore 098269

### EV Charging Details

| Detail | Info |
|--------|------|
| Provider | SP Group + Gentari |
| Total chargers | 20+ across multiple hotel car parks |
| Location | Hotel-specific basement parking (check your hotel) |
| Cost | Free for hotel guests (most hotels) |
| App required | SP Mobile (for non-guest charging) |

RWS has the largest hotel EV charging setup on Sentosa Island with over 20 charging points distributed across its six hotels (Equarius Hotel, Hotel Michael, Festive Hotel, Hard Rock Hotel Singapore, W Singapore Sentosa Cove, and the newly opened The Outpost).

The **Equarius Hotel** has dedicated EV charging zones with the fastest DC options. **Festive Hotel** is the most family-friendly with direct mall access for children's activities.

### Family Amenities

- **Universal Studios Singapore** — Southeast Asia's only Universal Studios. The **Far Far Away Castle** is a highlight. Tip: buy Express Pass if visiting on weekends (queues can hit 60+ minutes for popular rides like Battlestar Galactica).
- **S.E.A. Aquarium** — One of the world's largest aquariums. The Open Ocean habitat viewing panel is 36 metres wide and mesmerises children of all ages. Feeding sessions at 10 AM and 4 PM.
- **Adventure Cove Waterpark** — Rainbow Reef (snorkelling with tropical fish), wave pool, and water slides for all ages. You can rent snorkel gear and towels.
- **KidZania Singapore** — Interactive role-play city where kids 4-14 can try over 60 professions. Half-day activity (plan 3-4 hours minimum).
- **Sentosa Island Beaches** — **Siloso Beach** has gentle waves and lifeguards. Beach chairs and umbrellas available for hotel guests. **Palawan Beach** has a suspension bridge to a small island.
- **Skyline Luge Sentosa** — Unique ride down a hill on a wheeled luge cart. Kids 6+ can ride alone; younger children ride tandem with adults.
- **Festive Hotel** specifically offers families room options with themed bunk beds, separate children's sleeping areas, and connecting doors.

### Nearby Family Attractions

- **Butterfly Park & Insect Kingdom** — Thousands of live butterflies. Hand-feeding sessions several times daily.
- **Trick Eye Museum** — 3D optical illusion art. All ages enjoy this, but it's especially fun for 3-10 year olds who can become part of the artwork.
- **Sentosa Express Monorail** — Free for hotel guests, a fun little train ride that connects all the island's attractions.

### Verdict

Resorts World Sentosa is the ultimate family destination in Singapore. The sheer concentration of kids' activities — Universal Studios, S.E.A. Aquarium, Adventure Cove, and KidZania all within walking distance — means you never need to leave Sentosa. The 20+ EV chargers across the hotels make it the most charger-rich option.

## 4. Pan Pacific Singapore

**Location:** 7 Raffles Boulevard, Marina Square, Singapore 039595 — Marina Bay

### EV Charging Details

| Detail | Info |
|--------|------|
| Provider | SP Group |
| Total chargers | 8 (4x AC 22kW + 4x DC 50kW) |
| Location | Basement 2 car park, near lift lobby |
| Cost | Free for hotel guests |
| App required | SP Mobile |

The Pan Pacific has invested heavily in EV infrastructure. Eight chargers (half AC, half DC) serve the hotel's relatively small parking capacity, meaning availability is generally good. The DC 50kW chargers are the most popular — use the SP Mobile app to check live availability before arriving.

### Family Amenities

- **Pacific Club Lounge** — Key access only, complimentary for Club floor guests. Evening canapés (5-7 PM) with kid-friendly options, and all-day soft drinks and snacks. A godsend for families — it's like having a private dining room.
- **Kids' Pool** — Separate shallow pool with water fountains and small slides. The main 25-metre lap pool also allows children (floatation devices provided).
- **Family Harbour View Rooms** — Upgraded rooms with panoramic Marina Bay views. Connecting rooms available for larger families (book in advance). Rooms come with premium toiletries, Nespresso machines, and spacious bathrooms with separate rain showers.
- **Sunday Brunch at Edge** — Famous buffet with dedicated kids' section, live cooking stations, and an ice cream bar. Make reservations at least a week ahead.
- **Kids' Welcome Package** — Upon check-in, children receive a small activity pack with colouring books, crayons, and a plush toy.

### Nearby Family Attractions

- **Marina Square & Suntec City** — Connected indoor mall. **Marina Square** has an indoor playground and **Candy Empire** (a lolly shop that kids love). **Suntec City** has the **Fountain of Wealth** with evening laser shows.
- **Esplanade Theatres** — Free outdoor performances at the Esplanade Outdoor Theatre. The rooftop terrace has great Marina Bay views.
- **Ducktours** (5 min walk) — Amphibious vehicle tour that drives into the water. A 1-hour tour covering the Civic District and Marina Bay. Kids absolutely love the splashdown moment.
- **Raffles City** (5 min walk) — Shopping mall with **Toy'R'Us** and **FairPrice Finest** (for baby supplies and snacks).

### Verdict

Pan Pacific offers a compelling middle ground — less expensive than Marina Bay Sands but equally well-located for Marina Bay attractions. The Pacific Club Lounge is a huge value-add for families who eat multiple meals at the hotel. Solid EV charging at no extra cost.

## 5. Capella Singapore

**Location:** 1 The Knolls, Sentosa Island, Singapore 098297 — secluded Sentosa hillside

### EV Charging Details

| Detail | Info |
|--------|------|
| Provider | Charge+ |
| Total chargers | 4 (2x AC 22kW + 1x DC 50kW + 1x Tesla Destination) |
| Location | Open-air car park near main entrance |
| Cost | Free for hotel guests |
| App required | No — activated by valet |

The Capella has a smaller but well-maintained charging setup. The Tesla Destination Charger is a nice addition for Model S/X/3/Y owners. Charging is handled by the valet team — simply hand over your keys at check-in and your car will be charged and waiting when you need it.

### Family Amenities

- **Casa del Mambo Kids' Club** — A dedicated children's centre with supervised activities for ages 2-12. Arts & crafts, cooking classes (decorate your own cookies!), treasure hunts, and outdoor nature exploration. Open 9 AM to 6 PM. Professional nanny staff are CPR-certified.
- **Three Outdoor Pools** — Cascading pools surrounded by tropical gardens. The main pool (25m) is suitable for all ages. Poolside cabana rentals available (reserve in advance).
- **Capella Family Suite** — 78 m² with a separate children's bedroom featuring built-in bunk beds, a private TV, and child-sized furniture. The main bedroom has a king bed with views of the South China Sea. This is one of the best dedicated family suites in Singapore.
- **Auric Spa** — Spa treatments for adults while kids are at the club. The 90-minute "Parent Reset" massage is popular.
- **The Knolls Restaurant** — Michelin-starred dining that welcomes children. Highchairs, children's cutlery, and a kids' menu ($28 SGD for three courses).
- **Nature Trail** — The hotel sits on 30 acres of tropical grounds with a guided nature walk. Kids can spot monitor lizards, peacocks, and tropical birds.

### Nearby Family Attractions

- **Sentosa Island** (shuttle bus provided) — Free shuttle to Sentosa attractions including Universal Studios and S.E.A. Aquarium.
- **Palawan Beach** (5 min drive) — The most family-friendly beach on Sentosa, with gentle waves and the famous suspension bridge to a tiny island.
- **Mount Faber** (15 min drive) — Take the cable car from Sentosa Station to Mount Faber for panoramic views of the southern islands.

### Verdict

Capella Singapore is the premium choice for families who value space, tranquillity, and exceptional service. The Family Suite is genuinely designed for a family of four — not a standard room with a rollaway bed. The valet-handled EV charging removes all friction. If budget allows, this is the best luxury EV-friendly family hotel in Singapore.

## Tips for EV-Driving Families in Singapore

### Know Your Charging Apps

Singapore's charging ecosystem requires a few apps. Download these before your trip:
- **SP Mobile** — SP Group's network covers most hotel and public chargers
- **Charge+** — ComfortDelGro's network, especially at Shangri-La hotels
- **BlueSG** — If you're renting a BlueSG EV, you'll need their app for charging and parking
- **PlugShare** — Community-reported charger status with recent check-ins

### Where to Charge While Exploring

| Location | Recommendation | Charger Details |
|----------|---------------|-----------------|
| Gardens by the Bay | Basement car park | SP Group DC 50kW (6 slots) |
| VivoCity (for Sentosa shuttle) | Level 3 car park | SP Group AC 22kW (8 slots) |
| ION Orchard (Orchard Road) | Basement 4 | Gentari DC 120kW (4 slots) |
| Jewel Changi Airport | Basement 2 | SP Group DC 50kW + AC 22kW (12 slots total) |

### Important Tips

1. **Cross-border note:** If driving from Malaysia, ensure your Touch 'n Go card has sufficient balance for the PLUS highway tolls. The Singapore Tuas checkpoint has no charging facilities — charge at Aeon Mall Bukit Indah (15 min from Tuas) before crossing.

2. **Rental EVs:** If you're renting, services like **GetGo** (BYD Atto 3, Tesla Model 3), **Tribecar** (MG4), and **Lumo** (Tesla Model Y, BMW iX) all operate in Singapore. Most offer child car seat hire ($10-15 SGD per day).

3. **Charging etiquette:** Singapore has strict EV parking rules. You must move your car once charging is complete, or you risk a fine. Most hotel chargers give you a 30-minute grace period after 100%.

4. **Cable or no cable?** Many Singapore hotel AC chargers do not include tethered cables. Bring your own Type 2 cable if you want to use hotel AC charging reliably.

5. **Valet charging:** At premium hotels like Capella Singapore, simply hand your keys to the valet. They'll charge your car and return it ready. This is the most efficient option if available.

### Sample 3-Day Singapore EV Family Itinerary

**Day 1:** Arrive, check in (Capella or Resorts World Sentosa), charge overnight. Spend afternoon at S.E.A. Aquarium and Palawan Beach. Evening at Sentosa's food street.

**Day 2:** Morning at Universal Studios (arrive before 10 AM to beat queues). Afternoon nap at hotel while car charges. Evening at Marina Bay — Gardens by the Bay light show at 7:45 PM.

**Day 3:** Check out, charge at Jewel Changi Airport (free charging while shopping), explore the Rain Vortex indoor waterfall. Depart refreshed.

## Conclusion: Which Hotel Should You Choose?

| Hotel | Best For | EV Charger Count | Price Range (per night) |
|------|----------|-----------------|------------------------|
| Marina Bay Sands | Iconic experience, best location | 12 | $400-800 SGD |
| Shangri-La Singapore | Best kids' club, resort vibe in city | 6 | $350-650 SGD |
| Resorts World Sentosa | Most attractions, best value | 20+ | $250-500 SGD |
| Pan Pacific Singapore | Great mid-range, marina views | 8 | $300-550 SGD |
| Capella Singapore | Premium luxury, best family suite | 4 | $600-1200 SGD |

All five hotels offer free EV charging for guests — a massive saving considering Singapore's public charging rates average $0.55-0.75 SGD/kWh. If you're on a budget, **Resorts World Sentosa (Festive Hotel)** offers the best family-to-value ratio with 20+ chargers and a week's worth of attractions on your doorstep.

For a special occasion or if space is your priority, book the **Capella Family Suite** — it's the only hotel in Singapore with a genuinely separate children's bedroom. And if the skyline view is non-negotiable, **Marina Bay Sands** has the largest charging setup of any hotel in the country.
